title: Regarding the recent problem I encountered when opening Power Apps with Zscaler
summary: Power Apps customizations may fail to run on end-user machines when Zscaler security software is deployed, causing ProxyError and script loading errors during Go-Live despite working in UAT environments.
key_points: Zscaler Client Connector can block Power Apps from running on end-user PCs
Issue does not affect all custom Power Apps, only some
Works in development and UAT but fails during Go-Live on user machines with Zscaler
ProxyError and script loading errors indicate Zscaler intervention blocking access to required resources
Zscaler provides internet security through traffic inspection and policy enforcement

quotes.text: During Go-Live, we discovered that some customized apps (Not all) wouldn't run on the end-user PCs.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the specific environment where the problem manifests, helping implementers recognize the pattern during their own deployments.

quotes.text: We later discovered that the user had used Zscaler.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the root cause, enabling teams to check for security proxies when troubleshooting Power Apps failures.

quotes.text: Your organization has selected Zscaler to protect you from internet threats.
quotes.why_it_matters: The actual error message shown to users, helping teams identify Zscaler involvement from error logs.
